scope.included: Company and institutional lab releases, including adaptations of another publisher’s pretrained model; independently pretrained research releases; base, instruction, chat, trained-size and conversational multimodal variants.
scope.excluded: Community derivatives; recognition-only ASR/OCR, embeddings, reranking, classification, media-only generation, mutable routing, serving tiers, mirrors and quantization copies.
scope.publisher_verification: Use primary sources to establish company, institutional lab or community status. Hosting account type and external-base lineage alone are insufficient; uncertain cases stay pending.
